title: run_sse: comment says 'Lossy UTF-8 decode: skip invalid sequences' but push_str on lossy is actually lossful
description: The comment in run_sse says 'Lossy UTF-8 decode: skip invalid sequences rather than crashing'. But from_utf8_lossy replaces invalid UTF-8 sequences with U+FFFD (replacement character), it does not skip them. The replacement character then appears in SSE data and could cause JSON parse failures. The comment should say 'replaces invalid UTF-8 with U+FFFD'. In practice kithd sends valid UTF-8 so this never fires, but the comment misleads future readers about what lossy means.
